        ],
        'subtotal': '2841.18',
        'tax': '154.28',
        'total': '2995.46'
    },
    '002093': {
        'vendor': 'Firth Survey Services',
        'items': [
            ('Site survey, area 2', '1', '448.50', '448.50'),
            ('Travel time, route 2', '2.25', '64.80', '145.80'),
            ('Calibration standard, set 2', '2', '37.25', '74.50'),
            ('Additional sensor mounts, revised scope 2', '4', '18.95', '75.80'),
            ('Cable assemblies, shielded, length 2 m', '5', '11.40', '57.00'),
            ('Previously billed visit credit, ticket 2', '1', '-26.00', '-26.00'),
        ],
        'subtotal': '775.60',
        'tax': '90.64',
        'total': '866.26'
    }
}

# Write items.csv
with open('/results/tasks/user-5/items.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'vendor', 'description', 'quantity', 'unit_price', 'line_amount'])
    
    for invoice_id, data in sorted(invoices.items()):
        vendor = data['vendor']
        for item in data['items']:
            description, quantity, unit_price, line_amount = item
            writer.writerow([invoice_id, vendor, description, quantity, unit_price, line_amount])

# Write reconciliation.csv
with open('/results/tasks/user-5/reconciliation.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'subtotal', 'tax', 'printed_total', 'computed_total', 'difference', 'status'])
    
    for invoice_id, data in sorted(invoices.items()):
        subtotal = Decimal(data['subtotal'])
        tax = Decimal(data['tax'])
        printed_total = Decimal(data['total'])
        
        # Compute sum of line amounts
        line_sum = sum(Decimal(item[3]) for item in data['items'])
        
        # Computed total = subtotal + tax
        computed_total = subtotal + tax
        
        # Difference = computed_total - printed_total
        difference = computed_total - printed_total
        
        # Status
        status = 'matched' if difference == 0 else 'discrepancy'
        
        writer.writerow([
            invoice_id,
            f'{subtotal:.2f}',
            f'{tax:.2f}',
            f'{printed_total:.2f}',
            f'{computed_total:.2f}',
            f'{difference:.2f}',
            status
        ])
        
        # Verify line items sum to subtotal
        if line_sum != subtotal:
            print(f"Warning: Invoice {invoice_id} line items sum {line_sum} != subtotal {subtotal}")
        
        # Report discrepancies
        if status == 'discrepancy':
            print(f"DISCREPANCY: Invoice {invoice_id} - difference of {difference:.2f}")

print("Successfully created items.csv and reconciliation.csv")
EOF
